_comment_status: authoring -> review -> frozen. Only a frozen set may be used to report held-out results. ADR-0020 section 2 requires the freeze to happen before the components under test are tuned; freezing after tuning does not restore independence, it only hides that it was lost.
_comment_roles: Contributor roles, not names. The cross-authoring rule is checked against these.
_comment_categories: Quotas come from docs/design/comparative-evaluation-v2.md section 8. `systems_under_test` drives the cross-authoring rule: an episode in a category may not be authored or reviewed by an owner of a system that category evaluates.

standard.description: Complete, ordinary planning requests with no missing information and no conflict.

clarification.description: Required information is missing or ambiguous; the system must ask before planning.

safety_diet.description: Allergens, prohibited ingredients and dietary types. Violations here are never offset by other qualities.

budget_package.description: Real package sizes, package rounding, checkout totals and budget truthfulness.

nutrition_preference.description: User-stated calorie or macro targets and broad preferences such as lower sodium.

pantry_expiry.description: Known and unknown pantry quantities. Unknown quantity may affect ranking but must never be deducted.

infeasible_conflict.description: No valid plan exists. The system must refuse to fabricate compliance and must name the conflict.

multiturn_replan.description: The user changes something after a plan exists. Unrelated meals must survive.

_comment_language: Predeclared before authoring, per docs/design/comparative-evaluation-v2.md section 8. Languages are spread across categories rather than forming their own category, so that language never becomes a proxy for difficulty.
_comment_tolerances: Declared before authoring, per ADR-0020. Scoring compares against these rather than against whatever threshold makes a result look better afterwards. Money is compared in cents; quantities carry catalog units, so the tolerance is relative.
_comment_review: Every episode needs one reviewer who is neither the author nor an owner of a system under test. Disagreements are resolved before freezing.
